messages:
carmen: Heads-up: global p99 for /v1/complete jumped from ~180ms -> ~640ms at 07:22 UTC. endpoint breakdown shows p50/p95 flat but the p99 moved. suspect attribution/provenance problem.
diego: can you dump a few samples? curious if retries or a routed slow-path caused it.
carmen: paste below + console link: https://console.redwood/latency?endpoint=/v1/complete&range=30m
---
# samples (ts, route_initial, route_exec, latency_ms, retry)
2026-06-05T07:21:59Z init=primary exec=primary latency_ms=172 retry=0
2026-06-05T07:22:01Z init=primary exec=overflow latency_ms=642 retry=0
2026-06-05T07:22:02Z init=primary exec=overflow latency_ms=610 retry=0
2026-06-05T07:22:07Z init=primary exec=primary latency_ms=175 retry=0
---
anya: looks like two overflow execs inflated p99. Our API returns a single blended percentile and total_count. UX wise people assume it's the caller-side experience which is misleading.
diego: agreed. suggestion: add a tiny provenance timeline in the hovercard that shows how the percentile was composed: counts by (route_initial,route_exec) and percent contribution to the p99 bucket. small table like: primary->primary n=120 contrib=20%, primary->overflow n=4 contrib=65%, overflow->overflow n=2 contrib=15%.
carmen: +1. also flag retries: if retry>0 contributed to >10% of p99 weight show "retry-inflated" badge.
anya: backend note: computing exact contributor breakdown for p99 is expensive (needs order-statistics info). we can approximate by precomputing histograms / tdigest per <endpoint,route_initial,route_exec> at 1m granularity. storage delta estimate low-ish. metrics-bot: filing ticket METR-2204 to estimate cost.
diego: short-term: show per-route p99s and sample_counts in legend and a yellow "small-n" warning when any contributor has n<20. long-term: add hover provenance and retry badge.
carmen: API ask: add query param `provenance=true|false` to /timeseries to request the contributor slices. default false. add docs note about cost and cacheability.
anya: I'll draft the ingestion histogram plan and METR-2204 will hold the numbers. Carmen, can you make a tiny mock for the hover timeline?
carmen: will do. tagging this resolved for now; will follow METR-2204 outcomes. :white_check_mark:
